{{Quote|Dooku's representatives have just arrived. They will meet you in the skeleton straits|the Rodian mechanic|<ref name="The Clone Wars: Crash Course">''[[The Clone Wars: Crash Course]]''</ref>}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] was a member of [[Kidd Kareen]]'s [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] crew around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. He and the rest of Kareen's crew agreed with [[San Maxus]] to start helping the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] and [[Dooku/Legends|Count Dooku]] in order to make enough money to retire from [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] all together. While working on [[Mon Gazza/Legends|Mon Gazza]] the Rodian aided Maxus in fending off the undercover [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], as Skywalker had been snooping around Kidd Kareen's pit looking for Separatist contraband. The Rodian declared that an attack on one crew member was an attack on all crew members. The Rodian led a [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] [[Unidentified Gamorrean mechanic (Mon Gazza)|mechanic]], two [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] [[Unidentified Nikto mechanics (Mon Gazza)|mechanics]], an [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Unidentified Aqualish mechanic (Mon Gazza)|mechanic]], and a [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] [[Unidentified Toydarian mechanic (Mon Gazza)|mechanic]] into the fight. Kareen arrived shortly after the fight began and broke it up. Later the Rodian handed off the intel Skywalker was looking for to Maxus at the beginning of of the third lap of the [[Mon Gazza Speedway/Legends|Mon Gazza Maze]] during a pit-stop. Skywalker tried to stop Maxus but failed. The Rodian and the rest of the crew arrived, this time armed with [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]], to fend off the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and his [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] again. Anakin was able to throw debris at the Rodian and two others, knocking them out from the fight. Later, Kareen indicated that after it all only Maxus had been retired from the crew after being killed by [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], Skywalker's [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi Padawan]]. Kareen in fact offered Tano to take a job as a replacement for Maxus, but Tano refused.
